7.3 Error Classification
Section 7.2 "Error Handling" of the document "General Specification of Basic Software Modules" [4] describes the error handling of the Basic Software in detail. Above all, it constitutes a classification scheme consisting of five error types which may occur in BSW modules. Based on this foundation, the following section specifies particular errors arranged in the respective subsections below.
